title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
reason: Significant infrastructure security fix in Bitcoin Core discovered by AI agents, representing a notable intersection of AI and Bitcoin protocol security.

sources.summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.
